mapper.update: UPDATE pmis_execution_time_entry SET status = #{status}, approver_id = COALESCE(#{approverId}, approver_id), approver_name = COALESCE(#{approverName}, approver_name), reject_reason = COALESCE(#{rejectReason}, reject_reason), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pmis_execution_time_entry WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted = 0 AND entry_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY entry_date DESC
SELECT * FROM pmis_execution_time_entry WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 AND entry_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY entry_date DESC
SELECT * FROM pmis_execution_time_entry WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY entry_date DESC
SELECT * FROM pmis_execution_time_entry WHERE status = #{status} AND deleted = 0

SELECT employee_id, MAX(employee_name) AS employee_name, level_code, COALESCE(SUM(hours), 0) AS total_hours, COALESCE(SUM(overtime), 0) AS total_overtime, COUNT(1) AS entry_count FROM pmis_execution_time_entry WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'APPROVED' AND entry_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY employee_id, level_code ORDER BY total_hours DESC

SELECT entry_date, COALESCE(SUM(hours), 0) AS total_hours FROM pmis_execution_time_entry WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted = 0 AND entry_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY entry_date ORDER BY entry_date

SELECT initiation_id, MAX(initiation_name) AS initiation_name, COALESCE(SUM(hours), 0) AS total_hours FROM pmis_execution_time_entry WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND entry_date = #{entryDate} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY initiation_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT initiation_id) > 1
